mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES keep falling while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, weekday downtown trips weaken and retail footfall declines further over the next four weeks. The mechanism is a continuing loss of commuter-origin demand rather than a one-week shock.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -30.4 to -34.1 and WORKPLACES stayed near -30 over the observed window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 4-week mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES do not improve from the snapshot levels.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run rebound in grocery and pharmacy visits signals neighborhood errand traffic substituting for discretionary shopping; if GROCERY_PHARM improves next week, RETAIL_REC should improve within two weeks as nearby street activity spills into retail corridors.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns positive or rises by at least 3 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rebounded from -4.9 to -2.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after a week-on-week increase in GROCERY_PHARM of at least 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both rise together, leisure shifts toward local, low-cost outdoor activity and away from shopping districts, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks. This effect is strongest when park use is falling while home time is rising.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was negative in the last three weeks while RESIDENTIAL increased each week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both remaining above their t-3w levels.

mechanism_narrative: A fresh drop in TRANSIT below its current low indicates a mobility restriction or demand shock severe enough to suppress trips to retail corridors almost immediately. RETAIL_REC should decline within one week of a further TRANSIT break lower.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -35 or drops more than 2 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell to -34.1 at t-0w, the weakest value in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after TRANSIT crosses below -35 or declines by more than 2 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A December holiday shopping regime offsets weak commuting by increasing discretionary retail trips even when WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain depressed. Under this seasonal regime, RETAIL_REC should edge upward over four weeks despite the current commuter shortfall.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 28 days while holiday shopping season conditions persist.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS recover while RETAIL_REC remains weak, the activity mix is shifting toward recreation instead of shopping, and retail mobility will stay depressed over the next two weeks. The mechanism fails if park activity rebounds but retail corridors also attract more visits.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from a recent trough
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -10.6 to -4.7 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves within 14 days after PARKS rises by at least 5 points from its recent trough.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL indicates more at-home and local errand behavior, which diverts spending from discretionary retail. When both move up together, RETAIL_REC should weaken within four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 7.4 to 9.0 while GROCERY_PHARM improved at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while both GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL remain above their t-3w levels.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both stop declining and begin to recover, that marks a relaxation phase that restores downtown traffic and lifts retail mobility within one week. The effect depends on both commuting proxies turning up together.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises week-on-week and TRANSIT rises week-on-week after both were below -25
evidence_refs: fact:both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT were near or below -30 throughout the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days after both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT rise week-on-week from depressed levels.
